task: Add a story-scoped scope contract and changed-file gate so Koala can mechanically catch out-of-scope agent edits before REVIEW, TEST, and DONE.
outcome: 用户在一个 story 中先运行 `koala scope_contract_set ...` 声明允许修改范围；实现后运行 `koala scope_contract_check --storyId=B-be27 --json`，终端显示 `Scope gate: pass`。如果 Agent 修改了未允许文件，REVIEW/TEST/DONE 前显示 `Scope gate: fail`、违规文件清单和需要 `Scope change acknowledged` 的提示。
facts: B-1fca has already hardened evidence quality and fact-forgery defenses, but it does not enforce changed-file scope by itself.
Existing checklist items already support files.modify/create/test and story_review can compare understanding touchpoints to item files.
Koala has scope_check_save for PLAN scope review, but no productized story scope contract command or post-diff changed-file gate yet.
Reviewer advisories for this story require concrete userSees output and reviewer-visible scope change acknowledgement.
constraints: Story/checklist/background changes must go through Koala CLI commands, not direct JSON edits.
Old stories without contracts must remain backward-compatible unless strict policy or an explicit story contract requires enforcement.
Scope contract must be a current-state gate input, not a duplicate lifecycle history source.
Implementation must include tests proving allowed, blocked, shadow, and acknowledged cases.
